summary: Completed comprehensive testing of MEDILO multi-category quick-commerce transformation. All 13 backend tests pass. All frontend features verified via Playwright. Fixed 1 bug: CSV import VALID_CATEGORIES was missing 'Baby Care' and incorrectly mapping 'Beauty & Personal Care' to 'Beauty'.

issues: Minor: Console warning about missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility improvement recommended

passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/categories returns 5 categories (Medicine, Beauty & Personal Care, Wellness, Baby Care, Device)
Backend: Categories have required fields (id, name, icon, description, count)
Backend: Category counts match actual product counts
Backend: GET /api/medicines?product_type=Medicine filters correctly
Backend: GET /api/medicines?product_type=Beauty%20%26%20Personal%20Care filters correctly
Backend: GET /api/medicines?product_type=Wellness filters correctly
Backend: GET /api/medicines?product_type=Baby%20Care filters correctly (returns 0 items as expected)
Backend: GET /api/medicines?product_type=Device filters correctly
Backend: CSV import accepts 'Beauty & Personal Care' as valid category
Backend: CSV import accepts 'Baby Care' as valid category
Backend: Can create Beauty & Personal Care product via API
Backend: Can create Baby Care product via API
Backend: Customer login works
Frontend: Customer homepage shows 5 category tiles (Medicine, Beauty & Personal Care, Wellness, Baby Care, Devices)
Frontend: Prescription upload banner is visible on homepage
Frontend: Quick Reorder section shows for returning customers
Frontend: Clicking category shows filtered product listing in 2-column grid
Frontend: Product cards show icon, name, manufacturer, price, and Add button
Frontend: Add to cart button works and shows quantity controls (+/- buttons)
Frontend: Back button in category listing returns to homepage
Frontend: Search shows category filter chips (All, Medicines, Beauty & Personal Care, Wellness, Baby Care, Devices)
Frontend: Ops dashboard product type dropdown has all 5 categories

bugs_fixed.issue: VALID_CATEGORIES dictionary was missing 'Baby Care' category and incorrectly mapping 'Beauty & Personal Care' to 'Beauty' instead of 'Beauty & Personal Care'
bugs_fixed.fix: Added 'Baby Care' mappings and corrected 'Beauty & Personal Care' mapping to preserve full category name

critical_code_review_comments: ProductType enum correctly defines 5 values: Medicine, Wellness, Beauty & Personal Care, Baby Care, Device
Categories endpoint returns accurate counts by querying database
Frontend CATEGORY_CONFIG correctly maps all 5 categories with icons and colors
CartContext has getItemQuantity and decrementItem methods working correctly
Ops Dashboard SelectItems correctly lists all 5 product types
CSV import now accepts all 5 category values after fix
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-category quick-commerce features fully implemented and tested. 5 categories: Medicine, Beauty & Personal Care, Wellness, Baby Care, Device. Customer homepage uses mobile viewport (430x932). Category tiles use data-testid like category-medicine, category-beauty---personal-care. Search filter chips use data-testid like filter-medicine, filter-beauty---personal-care. Cart context has getItemQuantity(id) and decrementItem(id). CSV import VALID_CATEGORIES now includes Baby Care and correctly maps Beauty & Personal Care. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_multi_category.py
